# paper

> Agent-first, minimalist React design system styled with StyleX. v0.1.0. Components are copied into your project with the CLI: `npx paper add <name>`.

## button

Triggers an action in place: submit a form, open a dialog, save.

Use for:
- Submitting a form
- Confirming or cancelling an action

Avoid for:
- Navigating to another page: use a link
- Decoration or labels with no action

Practices:
- Do: Use one primary button per view; make the rest secondary.
- Do: Write the label as a verb that says what happens: 'Send message', not 'OK'.
- Do: Set type="submit" explicitly for form submission; the default is type="button".
- Don't: Restyle it with raw colors; extend the variants with color tokens. (paper check: no-raw-color)

Props:
- `variant?: "primary" | "secondary"` = primary. `primary` for the main action of a view, `secondary` for everything else.

Example `primary`:

```tsx
import { Button } from "../button";

export default function Primary() {
  return <Button type="submit">Send message</Button>;
}
```

Example `secondary`:

```tsx
import { Button } from "../button";

export default function Secondary() {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "1rem" }}>
      <Button type="submit">Save</Button>
      <Button variant="secondary">Cancel</Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## input

Single-line text field with a visible label, optional hint and error.

Use for:
- Short free text: name, email, search

Avoid for:
- Multi-line text: use a textarea
- Choosing from a fixed list: use a select or radios

Practices:
- Do: Always pass a visible label; the component requires it.
- Don't: Use the placeholder as the label or to hold instructions; use hint.
- Do: Set type and autoComplete so browsers and password managers can help.
- Do: Write errors that say how to fix the value, not just that it is wrong.
- Don't: Color the field with raw values to show errors; pass error. (paper check: no-raw-color)

Props:
- `error?: string`. Error message. Marks the field invalid and replaces the hint. Sets aria-invalid and links the message with aria-describedby.
- `hint?: string`. Help text under the field.
- `label: string`. Visible label. Required: placeholders are not labels.

Example `basic`:

```tsx
import { Input } from "../input";

export default function Basic() {
  return <Input label="Email" type="email" name="email" autoComplete="email" hint="We only use it to reply." />;
}
```

Example `with-error`:

```tsx
import { Input } from "../input";

export default function WithError() {
  return <Input label="Email" type="email" name="email" defaultValue="juan@" error="Enter a full email address." />;
}
```
